A built in window seat with storage drawers can be found in the dining room. The kitchen is directly off the dining room and has vinyl plank flooring. The home not only has a front porch, but a rear enclosed mudroom and off the master upstairs you will find a full enclosed porch that stretches the length of the house. There is a walk up attic that has not been used, but could potentially be another bedroom for a handy man or woman. There is a one car detached garage. The roof appears to be older, but the age is unknown. The hot water tank was replaced in Oct. of 2024.
